test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ‘Straight from the Heart: An Autobiography’ is an autobiography of which of following sportspersons?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kapil Dev**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kapil Dev**

 
 
• Kapil Dev is a **former cricketer who played for India**.
 
• He is also called **"The Haryana Hurricane."**
 
• He is one of **India's best all-around **cricket players.
 
• Kapil Dev served as the **captain of the Indian cricket team **that **won the 1983 Cricket World Cup**.
 
• He became the **first player with 200 one-day international wickets**.
 
• He enrolled as a** lieutenant colonel in the Indian Territorial Army in 2008**. 
 
• **‘Straight from the Heart: An Autobiography** is an autobiography of **Kapil Dev**. Numerous events in **Kapil Dev's life **are discussed throughout the entire book.**​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other than Straight from the Heart there are **various other books that are written by Kapil Dev such as:**

 
 
• Cricket My Style
 
• We, The Sikhs
 
• By God's Decree
 
 
 
• **Mahendra Singh Dhoni** known as** Mahi** is the topic of the sports biopic **M.S. Dhoni: The Untold Story**.
 
• Books that are written by **Sunil Gavaskar **are** Sunny Days, Runs 'n Ruins, The Sunil Gavaskar Omnibus**, etc.
 
• **'Wide Angle: Candid Moments from My Playing Days'** is a book which is authored by **Anil Kumble**.
